blocks.text: Actor Jake Vargas has signed with Crown Artist Management, the talent agency founded by actress Maja Salvador. The agency shared a video of Vargas’ contract signing on Instagram on Tuesday, Sept. 22. “Here’s to an exciting chapter ahead,” it said in its caption. “Welcome to Crown Artist Management, Jhake!” Vargas also posted a photo of himself with Salvador and her husband, Rambo Nuñez, as he thanked the agency for welcoming him.
